not_measured.hybrid_perplexity: the RAG context is prepended to the prompt, so a perplexity over the answer is not the same quantity for the hybrid variant; it is not reported rather than copied from the LoRA column
not_measured.hybrid_rouge: same reason; not measured and not reported

rerun_evidence.review_scope: rerun on the fixed harness by the repository owner agent; full independent external expert review was NOT performed
rerun_evidence.isolation_mode: container via an explicitly opted-in WSL/Ubuntu Docker daemon, --network none, read-only rootfs, non-root uid, --cap-drop ALL; successfully positive/negative controlled at review time
rerun_evidence.retraction_note: RETRACTED applies to the retracted ORIGINAL run, not to this re-run; new values were recomputed from reports/academic_benchmarks_raw_outputs.jsonl by tests. These numbers are descriptive for ONE 135M adapter and must not be quoted as a capability claim for the full zoo.
rerun_evidence.limitations: The sample contains 40 HumanEval and 50 RuMMLU tasks per variant; LoRA and hybrid show no measurable MCQ accuracy improvement at N=50. Do not infer any improvement from a -28pp RuMMLU accuracy difference as a controlled model-quality comparison.

retraction_reason: harness defects in the original run: substring MCQ scoring, Cyrillic homoglyph MCQ scoring (Russian prose such as 'в чём дело' scored as answer B), perplexity on blank generations, silent Base->LoRA copy when the adapter failed to load, and a HumanEval sandbox that was escapable and had no real containment
